mechanism: 让同一成年厨师、同一口锅和同一批可辨食材贯穿全片：抛料形成钩子，火焰与翻锅完成不可逆烹饪，食客反应验证过程，最后盛入一只固定碗完成成品证明。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One adult cook, one wok and one ingredient set persist through the entire state chain.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult cook, one wok and one ingredient set persist through the entire state chain."

invariants.rule: Raw, heated, mixed and plated states remain visually distinguishable and irreversible.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Raw, heated, mixed and plated states remain visually distinguishable and irreversible."

invariants.rule: Every flame or utensil action causes the next visible food state.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Every flame or utensil action causes the next visible food state."

invariants.rule: Crowd reaction occurs in the same stall and witnesses the real preparation.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Crowd reaction occurs in the same stall and witnesses the real preparation."

invariants.rule: The terminal bowl contains the same cooked ingredients and receives a stable proof shot.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal bowl contains the same cooked ingredients and receives a stable proof shot."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
